root_cause.text: The IFE action's `metalist` was stored in the persistent `struct tcf_ife_info` structure instead of the RCU-managed `struct tcf_ife_params` structure, causing new metadata to be appended to the existing list rather than replaced during an action update.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff moves the `metalist` list head from `struct tcf_ife_info` to `struct tcf_ife_params` in `include/net/tc_act/tc_ife.h`, and replaces `kfree_rcu` with `call_rcu` using `tcf_ife_cleanup_params` to properly clean up the old metadata list when the parameters are replaced.

bic_trace_step.reason: The commit introduces the IFE action. In `tcf_ife_init`, the metadata list `ife->metalist` is initialized only when a new action is created (`if (ret == ACT_P_CREATED) INIT_LIST_HEAD(&ife->metalist);`). During an action update (where `ret != ACT_P_CREATED`), the existing list is not cleared. Instead, `populate_metalist` or `use_all_metadata` is called, which appends new metadata to the existing list via `add_metainfo` calling `list_add_tail(&mi->metalist, &ife->metalist)`. This occurs because the `metalist` is stored directly in the persistent `struct tcf_ife_info` (referenced via `ife`) rather than in an RCU-managed parameter structure that gets replaced on updates.

The `metalist` is stored directly in the persistent `struct tcf_ife_info` structure (referenced as `ife->metalist`). In `tcf_ife_init`, when an action is updated (i.e., `ret != ACT_P_CREATED`), the list is not re-initialized or replaced.
